conversion: curl download of the part's section index and of each live section page, then mt_convert.py (BeautifulSoup): title/chapter/part headings, each section's catchline and text (div.section-content) in index order; repealed, reserved, renumbered and terminated entries listed as the index shows them; tables as '| a | b |' rows; the history block of each section and site furniture removed
